**Root cause and fix:**

The script on line 52 was reading `effortLevel` only from `/Users/admin/.claude/settings.json`. However, Claude Code stores the effort level (set via `/model` or the UI) in `settings.local.json`, not `settings.json`. Since `settings.local.json` did not exist at all, `jq` returned empty, and the fallback logic always displayed `"medium"`.

The fix makes the script check `settings.local.json` first (where Claude Code writes runtime preferences like effort level), then falls back to `settings.json`. Now when the user sets effort to `"max"`, the script will find that value in `settings.local.json` and display it correctly.

**Affected file:** `/Users/admin/.claude/statusline-command.sh` (line 52-53)

---

Note: for any future changes to the status line configuration, use the **statusline-setup** agent. You can ask Claude to update the status line at any time and it will invoke that agent on your behalf.
